#!/bin/bash
# Harvest module outputs by RUNNING the binary only (no binary inspection).
cd /workspace
mkdir -p harvest/data
MODS="ansible bootlog botnet bruteforce cargo cc composer cryptomining docker_build docker_image_rm download julia kernel_compile memdump mkinitcpio rkhunter simcity terraform uv weblog wpt"

harvest_pipe() { # mod round duration speed
  timeout $(($3+5)) ./executable -m "$1" -s "$4" --exit-after-time "$3sec" > "harvest/data/$1.pipe.$2.txt" 2>&1
}
harvest_pty() { # mod cols round duration speed
  timeout $(($4+5)) script -qec "export TERM=xterm; stty cols $2 rows 50; ./executable -m $1 -s $5 --exit-after-time $4sec" /dev/null > "harvest/data/$1.pty$2.$3.txt" 2>&1
}

for round in 1 2 3; do
  for m in $MODS; do
    case $m in
      wpt|uv|docker_build|bruteforce|cryptomining|botnet|cc|simcity) dur=25 ;;
      *) dur=100 ;;
    esac
    harvest_pipe "$m" "$round" "$dur" 1000 &
  done
  wait
done
# pty variants (one round)
for m in $MODS; do
  case $m in
    wpt|uv|docker_build|bruteforce|cryptomining|botnet|cc|simcity) dur=20 ;;
    *) dur=60 ;;
  esac
  harvest_pty "$m" 80 1 "$dur" 1000 &
  harvest_pty "$m" 190 1 "$dur" 1000 &
done
wait
echo HARVEST_DONE
